name: Shuffle
description: Glitch²-style Shuffle for NTS-3. Continuously captures about one bar of AUDIO IN (get_raw_input on firmware 1.4+) and on touch jumps between random sub-slices (sometimes reversed), with occasional repeats that fade. Y = sub-slice length. Depth = wet. Untouched = bypass. DECAY fades repeats. SYNC: EVEN, TRIP, DOT, FREE. HOLD: GATE or LATCH.

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Dry/wet while the effect is engaged

params.name: SYNC
params.detail: Time grid: EVEN, TRIP, DOT, FREE

params.name: HOLD
params.detail: GATE = hold to engage. LATCH = stays after release; switch back to GATE to stop
